Acceptance of Terms

Services Offered

The Style Hub provides professional hair and grooming services including but not limited to:

  • Precision haircuts and styling
  • Hair coloring, highlights, and toning
  • Keratin and smoothing treatments
  • Bridal and special occasion styling

Walk-in clients are welcome subject to stylist availability. Pre-booked clients are given priority at all times.

Introduction

The Style Hub ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights as a data subject. We comply with the Information Technology Act, 2000, and applicable Indian data protection regulations.

Information We Collect

When you interact with our website or book an appointment, we may collect:

  • Personal identifiers: Full name, phone number
  • Appointment data: Preferred service, date, time, stylist preference
  • Communication records: Messages sent via WhatsApp or our AI chatbot
  • Technical data: Browser type, device, IP address, pages visited (collected via cookies)
  • Special requests: Any allergies or service notes you voluntarily provide
We do not collect payment card details. No financial data is stored on our systems.

How We Use Your Information

  • To confirm and manage your appointments
  • To send booking confirmations and reminders via WhatsApp or SMS
  • To improve our website and services based on usage patterns
  • To respond to your enquiries and provide customer support
  • To comply with legal obligations

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to any third party.

Data Storage & Retention

Booking data submitted through this website is stored locally in your own browser via localStorage. This data does not transmit to our servers unless you initiate contact via WhatsApp or phone.

We retain personal data shared directly with us (via WhatsApp or call) for up to 12 months for service continuity purposes, after which it is deleted.

Third-Party Services

Our website may interface with the following third-party services, each governed by their own privacy policies:

  • WhatsApp (Meta Platforms, Inc.) — for booking confirmations
  • Google Maps — for directions and location display
  • Instagram (Meta Platforms, Inc.) — for embedded reels and social content
  • Google Fonts — for typography rendering

Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Request access to personal data we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate data
  • Request deletion of your data
  • Withdraw consent for communications at any time

To exercise these rights, contact us at +91 7018 330 781.

Children's Privacy

Our website is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from minors without verified parental consent.

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your web browser when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences, improve functionality, and gather analytics about usage patterns.

Cookies We Use

The Style Hub website uses the following types of local storage and cookies:

  • Essential (localStorage): stylehub_bookings — stores your submitted booking data locally in your browser. Not transmitted to any server.
  • Preference (localStorage): stylehub_theme — remembers your chosen colour theme (Dark / Light / Warm) across visits.
  • Third-party cookies: Google Maps, Instagram embeds, and Google Fonts may set cookies governed by their respective policies when those elements load on the page.
We do not use advertising cookies, cross-site tracking cookies, or third-party analytics platforms (such as Google Analytics) on this website.

Managing Cookies

You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may affect certain website functionality, such as theme persistence. Common browser instructions:

  • Chrome: Settings → Privacy and Security → Cookies and other site data
  • Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
  • Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Manage Website Data

Consent

By continuing to use this website, you consent to our use of essential localStorage items as described above. For third-party cookie concerns, please refer to the privacy policies of Google, Meta (Instagram), and other embedded services.

Updates to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy periodically. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy. Last updated: June 2025.

General Information Disclaimer

The information provided on the thestylehub.in website is for general informational purposes only. While we strive to keep all content accurate and up to date, The Style Hub makes no representations or warranties of any kind, express or implied, regarding the completeness, accuracy, reliability, or availability of any information displayed.

Service Results Disclaimer

Hair and beauty treatment outcomes vary significantly based on individual factors including:

  • Natural hair type, texture, and condition
  • Previous chemical treatments or colouring history
  • Individual scalp and skin sensitivities
  • Post-treatment home care practices
Results shown in our gallery, Instagram reels, or promotional materials are representative of our work and do not guarantee identical outcomes for every client.

We strongly recommend a consultation before undergoing chemical services such as keratin treatments, bleaching, or coloring for the first time.

Pricing Disclaimer

All prices displayed on this website are starting prices and indicative only. Final service charges may vary based on hair length, thickness, complexity of the service requested, and products used. You will be informed of the final price before the service begins.

External Links

This website may contain links to external sites including Instagram, YouTube, Google Maps, and WhatsApp. The Style Hub is not responsible for the content, privacy practices, or accuracy of any third-party websites. Inclusion of any link does not imply endorsement.

Allergy & Sensitivity Disclaimer

Clients are responsible for disclosing all known allergies and sensitivities to our stylists prior to any treatment. The Style Hub shall not be held liable for adverse reactions resulting from failure to disclose known sensitivities.

Patch tests are available upon request for chemical treatments. We strongly encourage first-time colour clients to request a patch test 48 hours before their appointment.

Availability Disclaimer

Appointment slots, service availability, and stylist assignments shown on this website are subject to change without prior notice. Booking confirmation via WhatsApp or phone is required to guarantee your slot.

Our Cancellation Policy

We understand that plans change. However, as a service-based business, cancellations directly impact our stylists' schedules and our ability to serve other clients. Please review our policy carefully before booking.

Rescheduling

  • 2+ hours notice: You may reschedule your appointment at no charge. Contact us via WhatsApp (+91 7018 330 781) or phone.
  • Less than 2 hours notice: Rescheduling may not be accommodated. Your slot will be released to other clients.
  • No-show: Clients who do not appear for their appointment without notice may be deprioritised for future bookings.
We recommend booking via WhatsApp so our team can reach you quickly for rescheduling coordination.

Refund Policy

⚠ No Refunds Policy: The Style Hub does not offer refunds on completed services under any circumstances. All sales of services are final once the service has been rendered.

This policy exists because professional services — unlike physical products — involve time, skill, and consumable materials that cannot be recovered once used.

Service Guarantee — Free Corrections

While we do not offer refunds, we stand firmly behind the quality of our work. If you are not satisfied with the service received:

  • Contact us within 48 hours of your appointment
  • We will schedule a complimentary correction session at no additional charge
  • The correction will be performed by the same or senior stylist
  • Corrections cover the original service scope only — changes of mind or entirely new styles are not covered
Our goal is that every client walks out loving their result. If something isn't right, we will make it right — free of charge.

Product Purchases

Any retail hair care products purchased from The Style Hub may be exchanged within 7 days if unopened and in original condition. Opened products cannot be returned or refunded for hygiene reasons.

Special Packages & Bridal Bookings

For bridal and special occasion packages requiring advance scheduling:

  • Cancellations made 7+ days before the date: full credit toward a future booking
  • Cancellations made within 7 days: 50% of the package value may be retained as a cancellation fee
  • Day-of cancellations: full package value may be retained

Bridal package terms are confirmed at the time of booking and supersede general policy where specified.

Contact for Cancellations

To cancel or reschedule, contact us immediately:

  • 📞 Call: +91 7018 330 781
  • 💬 WhatsApp: wa.me/917018330781

Please do not rely solely on the website booking form for cancellations — direct contact ensures fastest response.
